items.note: K1.1-K1.4 follow the proof at 741-766: net change (JV+RG)x independent of scratch, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 cancelled by side injection, and the stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). The headline K1 calls the three stages 'three forward invocations' although stage 2 is the inverse schedule (731-733), and h=100, the neighbour relations and the eight-row schedule are never given.

K2 states a common invertible frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and edge changes D_vD_u^{-1}, as at 804-815. It is an infer step with no sub-steps, and the route form eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} appears only as used in K4d.3.

Statement content is all present: triple-line inner products, nesting, only decreasing edges centre 3->4 losing h, L=Ich, sum Wm-2N+2L, F_2 orthonormal bases, ratios 100/539 and 101/539. But the gate-label table (eq:motif-labels) and the per-edge residual table that prove comparability are not reconstructed. K3.3 just repeats the lemma's conclusion, so the central verification step is missing.

Projections P_U with -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, endpoint difference I_m, shear H<-H+D on every role, rank equals dimension change, N rank-one source exceptions (2P_{U_a}), s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b and deficit N-2L_b>0 match 1112-1172 step for step.

Follows the proof at 1231-1315: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, odd weights giving eps=+-1, the phase-to-kernel identity via H diag(1,-1) H=X, the count s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c, zero/full endpoint labels and the X_a->Y_a correction with C=iZC^{-1}Z and i^{27k}. The k-column tensor version is not stated separately, a minor omission.

L/N<1/2, both deficits, eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta) and hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. This is the paper's route at 1319-1346. The exact values of eta_b and eta_c are not written out.

R2a and R2b are infer steps naming the O(V) operations. R2b's claim drops the condition that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time (it appears only in the quote) and the prime-to-q conditions on units. The cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W is stated only later, in K4d.1.

The shear route (triangular changes in O(V), E_1 Pi E_2, one interchange per pivot via D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j) is faithful to 1425-1447. But K4b is only stated, without the elimination proof at 1375-1392. The fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators (1397, 1413-1423), which the specialisation to Z/q^b needs, is missing from both statement and derivation.

Row split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} by recursive interchanges, common-frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, the three updates for the interchange, s calls on V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum and the depth-first parking schedule all match 1491-1615.

It borrows the top rho digits as rows with R=q^{2 rho}>=W^k and pads to R'<2R. The base-m pieces cost O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), binary chunks are padded to [q^e], and unequal widths take one bit move: the paper's proof.

Conjugation by P_M, one forward child per residual direction on the f axes of a slot, the inverse-child identity, Gaussian elimination into at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, exactly s_c children and H_0^{\otimes D}=b^D S_D C^{\otimes D} S_D are all present. The identity P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} is carried only in the method line.

Eight operations with cycles (00 01 10),(01 10 11), guard interval, union bound to delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0S_0^{-1} permuting B, swaps and rotations, radix-sort repair and the cost formula follow 2013-2205. The separate two-bit XOR for the top position j_{f-1} is not mentioned (minor).

Individual kernels O(Ve), node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks padded to multiples of W^{k_0}, u=Wg+w role split giving V/W children, the recurrence, internal sum O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), base-m pieces and lambda': the paper's argument at 2253-2448.

It writes the layer as b^D S_D C^{\otimes D} S_D and recurses through the complex network with packed basis changes. Guard bits come from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, giving Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p); the result is O(Vd^{lambda'}) with one truncation and error <sqrt2 2^{-p}. This matches 2450-2586 and the proof at 2686-2758.

Character cancellation by the shift t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency with bit reversal, the reversed procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, grouped rounds, layout L via prefix moves and Dq-1 chunk exchanges, a single truncation per round, the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} and the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1} all follow the paper.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the separation bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, carries in {-1,0} and {0,1}, centered residues, negacyclic reduction, the shift by p+l and four products giving O(rp log(rp)) match 3233-3368.
Normalization via the convolution theorem, P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), errors 2delta+eta then 3delta+eta scaled by M, and the cost with M=T/r products: the proof at 3414-3495.

Gaussian identity and ||N-I|| bound, Neumann inversion, A=S/2 and B_0=D'J'C with normalisations multiplying to 2^{-2alpha^2}, errors 16p, 3p^2/4 and 4, permutations left in the identity, tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2, padded-box linewise maps and axis exposure cost: the paper's route.

Chirp periodicity, the coefficient computation for QF_t, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+ with t_i units mod s_i, permutation commuting with pointwise products, the normalisations giving (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation for RF^+_s match 3938-3988.

Sizes, prime interval lemma, eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the prime search and the no-wraparound and capacity bounds follow 4049-4193. But the fixed exponents lambda=1-2^{-52}, c=2^{-56}, lambda'=1-2^{-54}, epsilon=2^{-75} and delta=1/16 are never stated, and the check that they satisfy the layer conditions (4018-4036) is missing.
Isomorphism by order counting, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i}a_jP_j, update order i=d..1, the identity on invalid controls, and cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) match 4204-4296.

Well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, diagonal isomorphism, wrap factor zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, plus twist errors of 4 each in F5.2, as in the paper.

The source transform 2^gamma B_0 QF_t A=RF_s, and digits scaled to a_j2^{-b-2}. The six steps (Phi, two transforms, pointwise product, F^+, scales by S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries) and the explanation of the two occurrences of S match 4486-4544.

Error chain E_ring<5TL, then 6TL and 8TL, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, then 2E_s+2 and 3E_s+2, E_w<28 2^gamma T^2L, and the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using gamma<=b/4. Rounding and carries with 0<=k_j<Q_0^2 and the 2n-bit output follow 4546-4806.

Cost table rows and powers, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2 kappa, o(Tp) setup and exceptional-stream sorting, log p powers <=p^kappa and the final O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}) with schoolbook below a cutoff, as at 4815-4995.
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n optimality conjecture but never states what an eventual lower bound means, or that one machine with liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 negates it (381-387).

errors.says: Three forward invocations of a fixed linear network send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restore every scratch wire.
errors.paper: The exchange is a forward invocation from X to Y at stage 1, the inverse forward schedule from Y to X at stage 2, and a forward invocation from X to Y at stage 3; the middle stage effects X<-X-Y.

errors.says: The layout L puts the selected bits at a common offset in consecutive K-bit chunks, so each round of the transform is one simultaneous layer.
errors.paper: Only the rounds on the remaining chunks use the simultaneous layer; the leading round on long axes and the rounds on prefix slots are processed bit by bit with individual butterflies (at most b+1<=K such rounds, cost O(TpdK)).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the radix-digit convolution through the two networks to the main bound. The steps run: the bank-exchange network, frames, labels, both interfaces and the exponent; then the interchange and layer recurrences; then synthetic transforms, signed packing, convolution, resampling with permutations left in the identity, chirp and cancellation; finally CRT, twist, algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins in three places. The label construction asserts comparability and the single decreasing edge (K3.3) without the label and residual tables. The lower-triangular factorization and the choice of the prime q are only stated or absent. The fixed exponents other than tau, sigma and kappa are never given, nor checked against the layer conditions.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary wire restored, the gate types and the triple-intersection coefficients are present. But h=100, the indexing of the banks by a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated. Within this verdict this is the weakest step.
Common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and an edge costs only the frame change D_vD_u^{-1}.

Nondegenerate labels from tensor products of triple-indicator lines, nested on every edge, with the only decreasing edges the central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h. The ambient space F^{\otimes 3} of dimension m is only implicit.
P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U for nested labels; the N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions.
L=Ich, telescoping to Wm-2N plus 2L for absolute changes, and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0), hence s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m at X_a), so the bit network applies H<-H+D on every row, including scratch rows.
Rank-a matrix factors as E_1 Pi E_2; the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V); the number of recursive calls is the edge-rank sum s.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central-saving chain. The steps run: the bank-exchange network with restored scratch; frames commuting with pointwise gates; nested labels with the single decreasing central edge; rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions; the budget W_bm-N+2L_b; the strict saving from L/N=100/539<1/2; the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D; edges as rank-many recursive interchanges; and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with tau=1-2^{-50}. Its main gap is that the network's parameters (h=100, triple indexing, N, m) are never written down, and the labels' verification table is asserted rather than shown.
